question: Which of the following was founded by Prashant Chandra Mahalanobis?
solution:
The correct answer is the **Indian Statistical Institute**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On December 17, 1931, he opened the **Indian Statistical Institute in Calcutta.**
 
• The institution was designated as "a**n institute of national importance" and a "deemed university" in 1959.**
 
• **Mahalanobis** made contributions to the field of statistics with his work and discoveries. The** Mahalanobis** Distance, abbreviated D2, is what most people remember him for.
 
• He also served on India's planning commission when the country gained independence. He became well-known for his work on** India's second five-year plan.**
 
• **The Indian government** decided to declare June 29th, the anniversary of his birth, as "**National Statistical Day**" in 2006.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• He also created the** Profiloscope**, a device used to measure the dimensions of the skull. He also made contributions to the **field of physical anthropology.**
 
• His contribution to large-scale sample surveys was the most significant. **Pilot surveys** were conceived by **Mahalanobis**.
 
• He developed a random sampling method that is thought to be the most precise in the entire globe. His research also enhanced agricultural yield estimates.
 
• He was particularly well-known for his **Mahalanobis Plan**, which was represented in the second draught of the **five-year plan** and called for significant investment in the establishment of **fundamental heavy industries.**
